POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL · 02

4 NOVEMBER 2026 · THE NEXT CHAPTER IS TOMORROW

Hi there,

Tomorrow, 5 November , I leave Curaçao and head for the next destination.

Where exactly? That part is staying a surprise a little longer. No destination names. No route spoilers. Just another chapter waiting to begin.

Before the journey moves on, here are three more Curaçao curiosities to take with you.

THREE LITTLE DETAILS TO TAKE ALONG

01 / DID YOU KNOW?

A bridge that steps aside.

Willemstad’s Queen Emma Bridge floats on pontoons and swings open to let ships pass. It links Punda and Otrobanda and is nicknamed the “Swinging Old Lady”.

02 / DID YOU KNOW?

A pastry worth knowing by name.

Pastechi are crescent-shaped pastries with fillings such as cheese, chicken or beef. They’re a popular breakfast snack on Curaçao.

03 / DID YOU KNOW?

Blue in the glass. Orange in the flavour.

Genuine Curaçao Liqueur is orange-flavoured — even the blue version. The distillery also makes it in clear, orange, red and green varieties.

The next place will join the website when it’s time for the reveal. Until then, the journey page is the place to keep following along.

One chapter closes. The curiosity stays.
